Method of Attack: Out-of-bounds memory write leading to remote code execution
Discoverer: Lucas Leong of the Trend Micro Security Research team
Impacted Systems: Microsoft Windows (all supported versions including Windows 10, Windows 8.1, Windows 7, and Windows Server Edition 2008 to 2016)
Attack Vector: Opening a specially crafted JET database file
Indicators of Compromise: Proof-of-concept exploit code published on Trend Micro's GitHub page
